title: ESE 2030 problem record
description: One multiple-choice problem. Authored as YAML at problems/<id>.yaml; compiled to JSON for validation and distribution.

id.description: Opaque, stable, assigned once, never reassigned. Encodes nothing.

legacy_id.description: Identifier in the pre-2026 quiz-keyed database, where one exists.

week.description: Course week = LAEF 2E chapter. MUTABLE. null until assigned (Phase 4); a null week REQUIRES status 'needs-review'.

skills.description: Ids into schema/skills.json. Every id must resolve, and its week must equal this record's week.

status.description: retired-2e marks a problem the second edition orphaned. Retire, never delete.

problem_type.description: Re-derived; null until then. 'survey' marks an end-of-quiz poll item that has no correct answer by design and must never be served as a quiz question.

statement.description: LaTeX, verbatim from source. Preamble macros are not expanded.

figures.description: Filenames under images/, keyed to this problem's id.

partial_credit.description: Choices earning partial credit, per the source answer key.

verified.description: true when the key came from a source file; false when solved after the fact and awaiting prof-g.

verified_from.description: Source paths that supplied this key. More than one entry means independent agreement.

conflict.description: Set when two sources disagree. Records both readings; resolved by prof-g, never silently.

distractor_rationale.description: Why a student picks a wrong choice, keyed by letter. Preserved verbatim from the source.

sources.description: Every appearance of this problem. One problem, many appearances.

semester.description: Term code (2025C), or POOL for a generated problem that has not yet appeared on an instrument.

instrument.description: quizN / final / midterm, or pool for a generated problem awaiting first use.

variant_of.description: Set when this is the same problem with changed numbers or wording.

topics.description: Free-text tags carried over from source % TOPICS comments. Search bait; not authoritative.

notes.description: Editorial notes. Not shown to students.
